_note: DOS CGA Phantasie III art (s160; tools/scripts/extract_dos_p3_graphics.py, importer P3Dos/P3CgaArt.cs; formats in reverse-engineering/dos/phantasie3/FORMAT.md section 10). CGA palette 0 high on every DOS III screen [~] (shots s81-s156). Never the default (auto_select false): drawn when no Amiga III pack is present (index fallback_order, a DOS-only import) or when chosen. Screens: TOWN.CMP, PICS.CMP (title, Astral Plane, Zeus, Pluto). Overworld: WORLD.CGA's 250 tiles of 16x16, tile = map byte, a 9x9 view (ovl3 0x12f1); the party's cell draws tile 89 instead of the map tile (overworld.party, opaque). tile_swaps: while on Scandor (region 0) ovl3 0x0 draws six tiles as others. Dungeon: SHAPES.CGA's 8x5 glyphs 46..52 with the cell map of ovl4 0x21bb (the Amiga's numbers). Monsters by DOS's own picture choice (root 0x10b8b: byte 27, minus 1 above 27; an index past the giants shows picture 15), except D3-067 (user s161): Wolf, Mud Elemental and Troll Baby borrow an analogous creature's picture as the Amiga pack does (Wild Dog, the party elemental, the party Troll; DOS: Skeleton, Skeleton, Forest Elf). Party pictures by race (DS:0x9ea), the elemental 22, the grave 24. Body figure: root 0xdcf, four sets (Okay green, Injured yellow, Broken red, Gone black). Scroll IV (item 126): the map of Scandor. No buttons, windows, flashes or scroll frame: DOS has none of these pictures. Every picture is opaque (DOS blits copy colour 0).
name: DOS (CGA)

tile_maps._tile_swaps: [region, map byte, tile drawn]: ovl3 0x0 swaps these while the plane (FAR 0xcc4) is 0, Scandor [C] (FORMAT.md section 10).

town_screen._note: The name sits on the picture's banner, black, centred near x 160 at y 16 (DOS shot s143_entry_done_town); the code that prints it is not traced [~]. Row 0-7 is the menu bar.

body_figure._note: root 0xdcf: 3 x 4 cells of 8x8; set s of stored piece p at SHAPES.CGA 0x3c40 + 192 s + 16 p, drawn at cell (p div 4, p mod 4). Draw order and areas: head 4, right arm 1 (the viewer's left), chest 5 (always Okay), left arm 9, right leg 2 and 3, torso 6, left leg 10 and 11; file body/<9 s + i> for the i-th piece below. Gone draws its black set (not a clear).
